description: RegIntel golden set. Every expected source was verified against the chunked corpus (data/manifest.json, verified 2026-11-13). Questions are paraphrased so they do not echo the source wording. `sections` are prefixes of the chunk locator ('4.1' matches '4.1.8'); an empty list means document-level only. `facts` are short strings a correct answer must state (used by the generation evaluation). `multihop` questions need every expected source (two or three passages) and are scored on all of them. `unanswerable` questions have no answer in the corpus; several are near-misses whose topic the corpus touches.
